items.title: What are lace front wigs NYC?
items.caption: What are lace front wigs NYC?

items.html:
Unlike traditional wigs, our lacefront wigs are constructed using wefted hair and breathable lace for a comfortable fit. All stock wigs feature full French lace along the hairline, complete with baby hairs and bleached knots for a natural-looking finish. They stretch from ear to ear for a better fit and can be installed without glue. Styling options are versatile, allowing you to create looks ranging from high ponytails to different front parting styles. Our wigs are made from 100% virgin human hair.

You Are A Perfect Candidate For A LACE FRONT Wig if……

  • ALL HAIR TYPES ARE IDEAL

Pricing

A consultation is recommended to determine the amount of hair, hair texture, length, and color that will be required for YOUR new hair extensions application.

REQUEST A CONSULTATION TODAY!

WHAT ARE LACE FRONT WIGS?

Lace Front Wigs, the Hair Replacement Technique, to Enhance the Beauty of Your Hair

Our full lace front wigs, lace frontals, and lace closures, made from 100% virgin human hair, are a great option for women and men suffering from mild to severe hair loss. We recommend our clients opt for lace wigs if they are weary about other options available for hair replacement. To create high quality and natural lace front wigs, we use 100% virgin Brazilian and 100% virgin European hair.


We Only Build The Highest Quality Wigs


We Create Lace Wigs for Long-term Use, Not Short-term

Our lace wigs will remain a part of your look for several years. Other wigs may make you feel conscious, but our lace front wigs will make you feel confident. No one will even know you are wearing a wig! We create our lace front wigs, lace closures, lace frontals using breathable French lace and hair weft.

To create our lace wigs, we have added French lace along the hairline with bleached knots and baby hairs. To ensure a comfortable fit, we have stretched the lace wig from ear to ear. More importantly, we do not use glue to install the wig.


No Limits to The Styles You Can Create! Get Your Wig On! Visit Us Today!


How Our Professionals Install Your Wig

To install the full lace wig on your head, we shampoo and condition your natural hair. We use a leave in conditioner and then blow dry your hair. Next, we add clips to your hair, if needed and moisturize your hair to prevent it from becoming dry under the wig. We braid your hair.

If you have short hair, we add extensions to increase its length. We oil your scalp, place the lace wig, trim it, and place it on your head via lacing method. We use the procedure to apply lace frontal wigs. Our lacing method offers a much longer and stronger fit, thus reducing the chances of the wig ACCIDENTALLY coming loose. Both full lace wig and lace frontal wigs offers full and complete coverage and conceals all of your natural hair.

Give Yourself a NaturaL Full Head of Hair

With Lace Front Wigs, You Will Achieve a More Natural and Healthier Look

Through lace front wigs, we have made it possible for people suffering from hair loss due to chemotherapy, medications, alopecia, and age to receive virgin human hair that looks and feels like their own hair. More importantly, it is undetectable.

Our lace front wigs are a suitable option for all hair types. We offer same-day consultations and installation.

Contact us at (212) 221-3881 to schedule a consultation for Lace Front Wig.

items.title: What are lace front wigs, and do they look natural?
items.html: Lace front wigs are wigs designed with a lace panel along the hairline to create a natural-looking appearance. Luxe Aura Hair offers wigs made from 100% virgin human hair, featuring breathable French lace, bleached knots, and baby hairs for a realistic finish. The lace extends from ear to ear, allowing for versatile styling and different front parting options.

items.title: Can you wear a lace front wig without glue?
items.html: Yes, certain lace front wigs can be installed without glue. Luxe Aura Hair's stock lace front wigs are designed with an ear-to-ear fit and can be installed using a lacing method rather than adhesive. Proper preparation and professional fitting help improve comfort and stability. Your stylist can recommend the most suitable installation approach based on your wig and hair needs.

items.title: Are lace front wigs suitable for hair loss caused by alopecia or chemotherapy?
items.html: Lace front wigs may be a suitable hair replacement option for people experiencing hair loss related to alopecia, chemotherapy, medication, or age. Luxe Aura Hair offers virgin human hair wigs designed to provide natural-looking coverage. The right wig depends on your scalp condition, hair loss pattern, and fit requirements. If your scalp is sensitive or undergoing treatment, consult your healthcare professional before installation.

items.title: How much do lace front wigs cost in NYC?
items.html: The cost of a lace front wig at Luxe Aura Hair depends on the hair texture, length, color, amount of hair required, and individual styling needs. A consultation is recommended to determine the most suitable option and provide personalized pricing. You can request a consultation with Luxe Aura Hair to discuss your wig and installation requirements.

items.title: How long do human hair lace front wigs last?
items.html: The lifespan of a human hair lace front wig depends on hair quality, frequency of wear, styling practices, and maintenance. Luxe Aura Hair designs its lace wigs for long-term use, with proper care helping preserve their appearance and condition. Gentle washing, suitable conditioning products, careful handling of the lace, and appropriate storage can help extend the wig's lifespan. Your stylist can recommend a care routine based on your wig and wearing habits.
